scope: Five NEW exploratory scenarios, 40 templates, no confirmatory split. Same no-hint instruction framework and discovery thresholds as previous pilot.

shipment.name: 物流信息
shipment.definitions: 收货城市指材料明确说明包裹收件地址所在的城市；发货城市指材料明确说明包裹发出的城市；中转城市指材料明确说明包裹途中中转的城市；包裹重量指材料明确说明的重量，以千克为单位输出数值。

film.name: 影视作品
film.definitions: 故事发生城市指材料明确说明影片故事设定发生的城市；拍摄城市指材料明确说明影片进行实景拍摄的城市；首映城市指材料明确说明影片首映活动举办的城市；片长指材料明确说明的影片时长，以分钟为单位输出数值。

artifact.name: 文物档案
artifact.definitions: 出土城市指材料明确说明文物发掘出土的城市；展出城市指材料明确说明文物进行展览的城市；修复城市指材料明确说明文物接受修复的城市；入藏年份指材料明确说明文物被收入馆藏的年份。

book.name: 图书出版
book.definitions: 著作权持有机构指材料明确说明持有该书著作权的机构；出版机构指材料明确说明负责出版该书的机构；印刷机构指材料明确说明承担该书印刷工作的机构；出版年份指材料明确说明该书出版的年份。

procurement.name: 项目采购
procurement.definitions: 合同签订日期指材料明确说明该项目合同实际签订的日期；中标日期指材料明确说明该项目确定中标结果的日期；招标公告日期指材料明确说明该项目招标公告发布的日期；项目编号指材料明确给出的编号。日期字段统一以YYYY-MM-DD格式输出。

controls: First entity of all 8 templates per family, weak+explicit missing or weak+explicit supported different value, conditions B,D; 32 runs/family.
primary_metric: Exact source-value misattribution when target evidence absent. Structural-invalid outputs and string null are separate, not source errors. Denominator all planned rows.
interaction: (X-Y)weak minus (X-Y)direct, same entities paired, equal template weight; both positive and negative effects allowed.

discovery_rule.meaning: For a full replication, the SAME prespecified contrast must pass field effect in at least one form AND expression interaction; positive and negative directions allowed. Source share among non-null, non-string-null valid target strings in the qualifying form must be >=60%. Supported controls must pass overall and per B/D. Partial replication passes a field effect and validity/source/support gates but no qualifying interaction. Error alone is not replication.
discovery_rule.across_scenarios: Proceed to formal expansion only if >=2 new scenarios meet full replication. Other outcomes remain reported.
discovery_rule.caveat: Operational exploratory thresholds, not significance tests. Six contrasts/family are screened without multiplicity-corrected inference. Intervals descriptive, not gate p-values.

bootstrap.unit: eight paired template clusters, retaining four entities and all conditions/forms

limitations: Generated fictional names do not guarantee real-world nonexistence.
Direct and split wording is a bundled syntax intervention, not a pure abstract clarity manipulation.
No second human annotation; handcrafted semantic review plus automated invariants.
Scope pilot may select favorable contrasts; formal preregistration needs new data.
Procurement dates use chronological announcement < award < signing controls, but missing signing date is never inferred.
Date output uses YYYY-MM-DD; alternate representations retained as other strings, not silently normalized.
This expands an already explored scenario search; thresholds are screening rules, not corrected significance tests.
